handwriting.set: ivritai-hw-bench-lines-v0: 225 handwritten Hebrew lines by 10 writers (phone photos), ivrit.ai Hebrew handwriting OCR benchmark, test split
handwriting.registration: ivritai_hw_lines_v0_2026-11-20; one registered run 2026-11-20 (heocr 0.2.0rc1; heocr 0.2.0 (identical to 0.2.0rc1, verified by wheel diff): byte-identical outputs, addendum 1)
handwriting.measure: line CER and WER under line_fold_v1, ratio of sums over all 225 lines, blank outputs included; words found = mean share of a line's reference words present in the output
handwriting.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 10 writers (2,000 resamples, seed 0)
